purpose: Certification and credential-state audit for Nigerian evidence linked to visible Sifter LevelUp domains.

interpretation.statutory_registration_and_practice_lice: A Nigerian regulator explicitly provides registration, licensing, a register or a practice authorisation pathway.
interpretation.sector_training_and_competency_context: A Nigerian institution or sector body provides training, certificates or named competencies, but a universal individual licence was not verified.
interpretation.sector_context_no_general_individual_lic: The reviewed sources provide sector or institutional context; no general individual Nigerian licence was found in this pass. This is not proof that no specialised credential exists.

credential_signals: NMCN registration after the professional qualifying examination
NMCN practising licence and licence renewal
competency_signals: general nursing and midwifery professional qualifying examination
registered nursing specialties and continuing professional development

sources.name: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria Registration
sources.supports: registration categories, qualifying examination and registration process

sources.name: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria Licensing
sources.supports: practice licence issuance, renewal and continuing professional development evidence

reviews.conclusion: Nursing has a Nigerian statutory registration and practising-licence pathway.
reviews.review_action: Use NMCN registration/licence as a bounded credential signal; do not present it as a generic nursing course certificate.

credential_signals: Veterinary Council of Nigeria register of veterinary surgeons
VCN registration, licensing and practitioner verification services
competency_signals: standards of knowledge and skills for registration as a veterinary surgeon
professional conduct and veterinary practice standards

sources.name: Veterinary Council of Nigeria
sources.supports: statutory mandate, standards of knowledge and skills, register and practice oversight

sources.name: Veterinary Council of Nigeria Practitioner Portal
sources.supports: profile approval and practitioner identity/licence verification workflow

reviews.conclusion: Veterinary practice has a Nigerian statutory registration and licensing authority.
reviews.review_action: Keep veterinary surgeon licensing separate from animal-health, livestock and production training credentials.

credential_signals: MDCN annual or life practising licence for dental practitioners
MDCN registration, licensing and credential verification
competency_signals: standards of knowledge and skill for dental practice
dental professional registration, ethics and continuing professional development

sources.name: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria
sources.supports: dental registration, annual/life licence, accredited dental education and professional regulation

sources.name: MDCN Guideline on Registration as a Medical or Dental Practitioner
sources.supports: registration and licensure requirements for medicine and dentistry

reviews.conclusion: Dentistry has a Nigerian statutory registration and practising-licence pathway through MDCN.
reviews.review_action: Keep dental therapy and other oral-health cadres as separate regulated pathways where their own board data is available.

credential_signals: National Diploma and Higher National Diploma agriculture certificates through ARCN colleges
short courses and agricultural personnel training

sources.name: Agricultural Research Council of Nigeria
sources.supports: agricultural research, training and extension mandates

sources.name: Federal College of Agriculture, Ibadan, ARCN
sources.supports: practical skills, ND/HND certificates and short competency courses

reviews.conclusion: Nigeria has strong agricultural training and competency evidence, but this pass did not verify one general statutory licence for every agricultural role.
reviews.review_action: Show agriculture credentials by pathway or occupation; do not imply that every agriculturist needs one national practice licence.

credential_signals: National Institute of Sports certificates, diplomas and higher diplomas for sports administrators, coaches and technicians

sources.name: Federal Ministry of Sports Development Strategic Plan
sources.supports: National Institute of Sports training and sports administration mandate

sources.name: NCCE Nigeria Certificate in Education sports management curriculum
sources.supports: sports organisation, administration, leadership and event-management competencies

reviews.conclusion: Nigeria has sports-management training and sector institutions, but this pass did not verify a general individual sports-manager licence.
reviews.review_action: Use training and role competencies; avoid displaying a licence requirement unless a specific sports occupation or federation requires one.

credential_signals: NiMet regional training and meteorological education capacity-building
competency_signals: meteorological data collection, processing and dissemination

sources.name: Nigerian Meteorological Agency
sources.supports: national meteorological mandate, services, observation, forecasting and research

sources.name: Regional Training Centre Nigeria meteorology handbook
sources.supports: meteorology training and certificate pathway; not a general independent practice licence

reviews.conclusion: Nigeria has official meteorology services and training evidence, but this pass did not verify a universal individual meteorologist licence.
reviews.review_action: Present NiMet and training credentials as sector or role-specific evidence, with the licensing field left bounded and explicit.

credential_signals: institutional museum, heritage and visual-arts capacity-building

sources.name: National Commission for Museums and Monuments functions
sources.supports: collection, documentation, conservation, preservation, research and public presentation mandates

sources.name: National Gallery of Art Nigeria
sources.supports: national visual-arts and gallery-sector context

reviews.conclusion: The reviewed Nigerian sources provide museum, heritage and gallery competencies but no general individual professional licence for curators or archivists.
reviews.review_action: Use training, portfolio and institution-specific evidence; do not invent a Nigerian curator or archivist licence.

credential_signals: NASENI nanotechnology and advanced-materials capacity-building and research programmes
competency_signals: instrumentation, materials analysis and interdisciplinary research

sources.name: NASENI Centre of Excellence in Nanotechnology and Advanced Materials
sources.supports: national nanotechnology capacity-building, research themes and skills mandate

sources.name: Raw Materials Research and Development Council
sources.supports: Nigerian raw-materials research and industrial development context

reviews.conclusion: Nigeria has nanotechnology and advanced-materials research capacity, but this pass did not verify a general individual nanotechnology licence or national practitioner credential.
reviews.review_action: Use research, laboratory and engineering credentials from the relevant discipline; do not create a standalone Nigerian nanotechnology licence.

credential_signals: institutional research training and professional association membership where applicable

sources.name: Nigerian Academy of Science
sources.supports: scientific professional community and research excellence context

sources.name: Nigerian Institute of Medical Research
sources.supports: research institution and scientific research context

sources.name: Nigerian Institute of Social and Economic Research
sources.supports: social and economic research context

reviews.conclusion: The reviewed Nigerian sources support research competencies and institutional pathways, but not one general individual licence covering scientific or social research roles.
reviews.review_action: Represent degrees, research methods, publications, projects and bounded memberships; do not show a universal research licence.

credential_signals: forestry, conservation and environmental training or academic qualifications

sources.name: Forestry Association of Nigeria
sources.supports: Nigerian forestry professional association context

sources.name: National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency
sources.supports: environmental compliance and enforcement context

reviews.conclusion: The reviewed sources support forestry and environmental competencies, but no general individual forestry or wildlife-management licence was verified.
reviews.review_action: Use academic, field and conservation credentials and identify permits only where a specific activity requires them.

credential_signals: institutional theological, ministry or faith-organisation training may apply by denomination

sources.name: Federal Ministry of Arts, Culture and the Creative Economy
sources.supports: national cultural-sector context only; no religious professional licence inferred

reviews.conclusion: No general Nigerian individual religious-ministry licence was verified in this pass; credentials are usually institution or denomination specific.
reviews.review_action: Keep ministry credentials denomination-specific and clearly label the source institution; do not infer government licensing.
